model.name: Scenario link on ALL detail views
model.description: Every detail-view component renders a 📄 Scenario link to its own underlying scenario unit, so any detail view (task, WebItem, member, file, requirement, etc.) exposes a one-click path to the unit that backs it - uniformly across ALL detail components.
model.tronQuote: > TRON: every detail view shall show a 📄 Scenario link to its underlying scenario unit (all detail components, uniformly).
model.implRef: ior:file:src/public/ts/trace/rb-*-detail.ts (the detail-view components: rb-task-detail, rb-webitem-detail, rb-detail-drawer, member/file detail) — add a uniform 📄 Scenario link to each.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Every detail-view component renders a 📄 Scenario link.
The link resolves to the underlying scenario unit (the /scenario or /md view of that unit's uuid).
The link appears on ALL detail components uniformly (task, WebItem, member, file, requirement, drawer, ...), not just one.
The 📄 Scenario affordance is placed/styled consistently across detail views.

model.crossRefNote: Sibling concern to R22.3 (chain-node source links): R22.3 links chain nodes to their source artifacts; R25.6 adds a 📄 Scenario link on every DETAIL view to its own unit.
